title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping Bitcoin is trading barely above its realized price, the average cost of every coin, and a break below would put the average holder at a loss for the first time since early 2023. This post Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
